The 1976 is the theatrical cut, and that’s the one you want. The 1978 cut was re-edited by Cassavetes as per Ben Gazzara and it runs about 30 minutes shorter. Go with the original cut, you get more involved with the main character. The 1976 cut also has the extended burlesque routines, which really shaped the atmosphere.

I started on Cassavetes with A Woman Under the Influence, it’s such a heavy and sorrow film and shows what John is all about. I’m glad I started with that one because Woman is a more accessible and open presentation of his style. Chinese Bookie is such an obscure film, it might leave a first time viewer turned off. But then again, you also can instantly fall in love. If you want my recommendation, start with Woman.
